verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox that confines Cline's code execution, tool calls, or network access. The closest items are adjacent controls: human-in-the-loop approval, Auto Approve and YOLO settings, a read-only Plan mode (a dry-run-style restriction, not isolation), and per-card git worktrees in Kanban (file-level workspace separation, not a sandbox for tools or network). None of these is sandboxed execution, so the applicable axis earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have the agent operate inside a sandbox when interacting with code, tools, and network resources
